rows.definition: Proportion of paired-control carrier-available edges still carrier-available under A-, per seed.
Proportion of paired-control served edges still served under K-, per seed.
Maximum absolute A, K or Y availability-rate difference on non-target edges against the paired control.
Absolute A formation-rate difference between Y- and the paired no-Y- control.
Absolute K formation-rate difference between Y- and the paired no-Y- control.
Assertion rate in A-K-; above the ceiling is THIRD ROUTE PRESENT.

source: Design convention fixed 2026-11-14 before any A1 cell. No A0 row, seed or run result was used to choose a value.
fragility: At 26 paired carrier rows, a 0.95 preservation floor allows one edge to differ and fails at two; at larger denominators it allows proportionally more. A descriptive sensitivity at 0 and 0.10 is reported beside the result but cannot change the precommitted gate.
missing_denominator: A condition with no available edges is NOT MEASURABLE, not zero, and does not pass.
not_evidence: Thresholds and definitions only. No cell has run; this is not a grant and makes no causal, capability or transfer claim.
